verdict.rationale: Attio documents an official MCP server and a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec covering records. AI tools can connect to search, update and manage the workspace, so an agent can create and update lead records. The pricing page lists automatic data enrichment, but the evidence never shows enrichment being triggered through the API or MCP, or an owner being assigned programmatically; lead routing appears only as an in-app workflow agent. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP-driven company-data enrichment, documented owner assignment via API/MCP, end-to-end agent example or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner
